lines.text: Paul sends Tychicus and Onesimus to tell the Colossians all the news about him.
Aristarchus, Paul's fellow prisoner, sends greetings, as does Mark, the cousin of Timothy.
Epaphras is always wrestling in prayer for the Colossians and goes to great pains for them.
Paul tells the Colossians to have this letter read in another church and to read the letter from Corinth.
Paul tells Archippus to complete his ministry, then writes in his own hand and asks them to remember his chains.
